entries.name: Iberian lynx
behaviour: solitary and territorial
specialist hunter of european_rabbit
scent-marks with urine and scratches

voxel_model.pattern: spotted coat, ear tufts and beard ruff

entries.notes: The poster species: Europe's most endangered cat, recovered from under 100 to over 2000 animals by rabbit recovery and captive breeding.

entries.name: Wild boar
behaviour: matriarchal sounders of sows and young
excavates soil with its snout for roots
nocturnal where hunted or disturbed
entries.notes: The Mediterranean oak woodlands' earthmover; prized game, and a driver of both acorns and crop damage.

entries.name: Red fox
behaviour: caches surplus food
pounces on vole runs through grass
dens up to raise cubs in spring
entries.notes: The adaptable opportunist of every open habitat; they thrive on the rabbit and rubbish of Mediterranean farmland.

entries.name: Iberian wolf
behaviour: small packs that hunt cooperatively
nocturnal when near people
howls to bond and mark territory

voxel_model.pattern: dark saddle markings on a tawny coat

entries.notes: The smallest European wolf subspecies; the stronghold is northwest Iberia, with a relict population south of the Duero.

entries.name: Barbary macaque
behaviour: tailless ape-like macaque troops in the Atlas and on the Rock of Gibraltar
grooming networks bind the troop
raids farms and orchard edges

voxel_model.pattern: shaggy tan coat, pink-brown face

entries.notes: The only wild primate in Europe (Gibraltar); native Atlas Mountain forests are urgently shrinking.

entries.name: Spanish ibex
entries.migrates: altitudinal: summers on high pastures, winters lower down
behaviour: ewes and kids in cliff herds
mature males alone or in bachelor groups
sure-footed on near-vertical rock
entries.notes: A pyrenean icon; the bucardo subspecies was declared extinct in 2000, its last clone dying minutes after birth.

entries.name: Fallow deer
behaviour: rutting bucks groan and fight in the autumn
white-spotted mahogany coats, but melanism and leucism occur
herds loosely organized by sex outside the rut

voxel_model.pattern: white spots on a chestnut coat, black-edged tail

entries.notes: Ancient Roman-era transplant across the Mediterranean; populations across Iberia and Italy are often descended from park deer.

entries.name: Red deer
behaviour: stags roar through the rut to warn rivals
hinds and calves in herds separate from stags outside the rut
freezes motionless when alarmed, then bounds off
entries.notes: The signature quarry of oak dehesa country; hispanic stags are darker and smaller than northern forms.

entries.name: Mediterranean monk seal
behaviour: hauls out in sea caves, where it pups
solitary forager along rocky coasts
famously hauls into fishing nets and coves near people

voxel_model.pattern: dark back, pale belly patch

entries.notes: One of the rarest marine mammals; fewer than about 700 remain, pupping mostly in cliff sea caves.

entries.name: Egyptian mongoose
behaviour: lives in small family groups
stands on a lookout rock to scan
historically stalked cobra holes; tameable in Egyptian lore

voxel_model.pattern: grizzled grey-brown, dark tail

entries.notes: The only mongoose in Europe (Iberia); an efficient nest-robber of turtles, ground-nesting birds and farms.

entries.name: Stone marten
behaviour: solitary climber of stonework and roof voids
caches food in holes
infamous for chewing car wiring

voxel_model.pattern: white throat bib on a brown coat

entries.notes: The ferret of Mediterranean villages; dens in caves, ruins and barns, hunting by night.

entries.name: European mouflon
behaviour: introduced to Corsica and Sardinia in antiquity as living meat
rams live alone, ewes in flocks
head-butts and clashing horns in the rut

voxel_model.pattern: dark back saddle, white rump patch (rams)

entries.notes: A shaggy wild sheep of high Mediterranean islands; the closest living relative of the ancestor of domestic sheep.

entries.name: Common genet
behaviour: solitary and cat-like, bounding through trees and stone walls
scent-marks like a mustelid, silent like a cat
has been kept for centuries to rid houses of rats

voxel_model.pattern: bold black spots in rows, black-and-white ringed tail

entries.notes: The elegant opossum-cat of Mediterranean stone walls; historically tamed for rodent control before cats took over.

entries.name: European wildcat
behaviour: stocky, thick-tailed forest tabby
dens in rock crevices and old badger setts
hybridizes with domestic cats wherever people keep them

voxel_model.pattern: thick banded tail with a black blunt tip, faint tabby stripes

entries.notes: Every Mediterranean oak forest's secret tiger; hybridisation with feral cats threatens genetic purity.

entries.name: Golden eagle
entries.migrates: partial: adults resident, young birds wander
behaviour: soars on thermals along cliff lines and ridges
stoops onto prey from hundreds of metres
mated for life; nests reused for decades

voxel_model.pattern: golden-napes and hood over dark brown body

entries.notes: The eagle of eagles; each pair commands a huge cliff territory centred on open hill country with rabbits.

entries.name: Griffon vulture
behaviour: soars in communal thermals and cliff colonies
bald head keeps feathers clean when feeding deep in carcasses
warns other scavengers of locations by circling

voxel_model.pattern: pale ruff and head, tawny body and flight feathers

entries.notes: The Mediterranean's cleanup crew; Spain holds over 90% of Europe's population, soaring over vulture restaurants.

entries.name: Cinereous vulture
behaviour: largest vulture in Europe; takes the deepest carrion
nests on cliffs but also in tall pines
pairs soar together in courtship circles
entries.notes: The black vulture; native relict in Iberia and the eastern Mediterranean, winkled from giant open-air aerialists' ledges.

entries.name: Egyptian vulture
entries.migrates: winters in sub-Saharan Africa; summer breeder in Europe
behaviour: uses stones to crack open ostrich and tortoise eggs
bright yellow face flushes deeper pink in alarm
follows caravans and flocks for scraps

voxel_model.pattern: white body and tail, black flight feathers, yellow bare face

entries.notes: The famed tool-using vulture of pharaohs; Europe's most endangered vulture, crashing in the Balkans.

entries.name: Bonelli's eagle
behaviour: nests on cliff ledges near open ground with prey
hunts in tandem along watercourses
tolerates a close paragliding human audience

voxel_model.pattern: dark above, pale below, with a white back patch

entries.notes: One of Europe's most threatened eagles; the Mediterranean coastlines with pigeons and cliffs are its last strongholds.

entries.name: Eurasian eagle-owl
behaviour: booming territorial song on calm winter nights
takes prey up to fox size
nests on cliff ledges and old raptor nests

voxel_model.pattern: orange eyes, long ear tufts, mottled buff and brown

entries.notes: Europe's largest owl; a sit-and-pounce apex of the night, loud enough to turn the blood cold.

entries.name: Greater flamingo
entries.migrates: nomadic: follows water levels in saline lagoons
behaviour: breeds in vast colonies on mud islands in saline lagoons
feeds with head upside down, straining brine shrimp
pink comes from carotenoid pigments in food

voxel_model.pattern: salmon-pink body, black bill tip and leg joints

entries.notes: Doñana, the Camargue and Cyprus each host pink seas of flamingos; shallow salt pans are the key habitat.

entries.name: Red-legged partridge
behaviour: coveys burst into whirring low flight with a cackling chuck
double-clutching: she lays a second batch for the male to raise
scratches dust baths on farm tracks

voxel_model.pattern: grey flanks barred black, white throat bordered black, red beak and legs

entries.notes: Iberia's iconic gamebird; half a century of quarry management, and autumn coveys still crash up from stubble.

entries.name: European bee-eater
entries.migrates: winters in sub-Saharan Africa; summer breeder in Europe
behaviour: nests in colonies in soft sand banks
catches bees mid-air and strips the sting on a perch
gathers in noisy chattering pre-migration roosts

voxel_model.pattern: chestnut crown, turquoise belly, yellow throat with black gorget

entries.notes: A rainbow darting over harvested fields; colonies nest in river-cut sandy banks.

entries.name: Eurasian hoopoe
entries.migrates: winters in sub-Saharan Africa; summer breeder in Europe
behaviour: walks swaying like a tiny dinosaur with crest raised
probes soil with a long curved bill
nests in tree cavities, walls and nest boxes

voxel_model.pattern: salmon-orange body, zebra-barred black-and-white wings, crown crest

entries.notes: National bird of Israel and a spring herald across the Mediterranean; nests stink of its own defensive musk.

entries.name: Common kestrel
behaviour: hovers over grass and road edges head-wind against the wind
sees ultraviolet urine trails of voles
nests on cliffs, ruins and church towers

voxel_model.pattern: rusty back with black spots, blue-grey male head and tail

entries.notes: The hovering falconry bird of telephone wires; an everyday raptor of road verges and olive groves.

entries.name: Iberian magpie
behaviour: gregarious pastel-blue jay of dehesa and pine groves
mobs predators in chattering gangs
plant seeds by burying acorns and forgetting them

voxel_model.pattern: black hood and bib, white throat, steel-blue wing and tail

entries.notes: Endemic to southwest Iberia; the confusing mis-match between a Corvid of Asia and this one is a biogeography mystery.

entries.name: Hermann's tortoise
behaviour: basks motionless on south-facing scrub
stamps and rams rival males in the mating season
hibernates in burrows in winter

voxel_model.pattern: yellow shell boldly blotched with black

entries.notes: A living relic of sunny scrub; western boettgeri and eastern boettgeri races differ in size and shell glow.

entries.name: Marginated tortoise
behaviour: largest native European tortoise
flared rear marginal scutes give a frilled shell skirt
summer aestivation and winter hibernation both underground

voxel_model.pattern: dark, finely lined shell with flared rear edge

entries.notes: An antique tortoise of the Peloponnese; slow even by tortoise standards, and fiercely sought by collectors.

entries.name: Spur-thighed tortoise
behaviour: horny spur on each thigh gives the name
dozes through the summer drought in scrub
Malagasy and Greek pet trade threaten wild stocks

voxel_model.pattern: sandy shell with dark blotches, thigh spur, no horny tail tip

entries.notes: The tortoise of the African shore and southeast Iberia; more tolerant of aridity than Hermann's.

entries.name: Ocellated lizard
behaviour: largest lizard in western Europe, up to 90 cm total
males glare upright on lookout stones, throat flaring blue
rival males fight with biting and shoving matches

voxel_model.pattern: green with blue ocelli eyespots on flanks, blue throat patches

entries.notes: A green and sapphire dinosaur of stone walls and vine terraces; hunters used to catch it with dogs for the table.

entries.name: Mediterranean chameleon
behaviour: rocks side to side, mimicking wind-blown leaves
eyes swivel independently, then converge to fire the tongue
color shifts signal mood and temperature, not camouflage

voxel_model.pattern: laterally compressed body, dorsal crest, swiveling turret eyes

entries.notes: The only chameleon native to Europe; a fragile, slow-moving insect of coastal scrubland and citrus groves.

entries.name: European pond turtle
behaviour: slips from basking logs into warm shallow water
walks long distances overland between ponds
dozes through winter buried in pond mud

voxel_model.pattern: dark shell and skin with fine yellow speckling

entries.notes: Europe's only freshwater turtle; Mediterranean ponds and slow streams, now outcompeted by exotic red-eared sliders.

entries.name: Common wall lizard
behaviour: dozens pile onto sunlit stone walls at noon
drops its tail when grabbed
push-ups to flash rival males on warm rock

voxel_model.pattern: fine speckling on grey-brown, males with blue-flecked flanks

entries.notes: The wallpaper of old stone everywhere in Mediterranean lands; the commonest lizard north of the sea.

entries.name: Mediterranean tree frog
behaviour: chorus of hundreds of deafening voices after rain
sticky toe pads let it climb olive branches
dormant through the summer drought in dense green leaves

voxel_model.pattern: smooth apple-green with a dark eye-to-flank stripe

entries.notes: The voice of warm spring nights; in a good April, a single pool can hold an entire village's worth of noise.

entries.name: European mantis
behaviour: waits motionless with forelegs upraised
females sometimes eat males after mating
eggs overwinter in a foam ootheca attached to stems

voxel_model.pattern: green or straw-brown, with an eyespot on the underwing

entries.notes: A living statue in the olive grove; adults appear in late summer and vanish with the first cold.

entries.name: Old World swallowtail
entries.migrates: partial: some individuals wander and disperse widely
behaviour: fast strong hilltop flight on warm thermals
males patrol in circles over ridges
caterpillars on fennel, carrot and wild fenugreek

voxel_model.pattern: yellow wings with black veins, blue hindwing marginal spots and tail streamers

entries.notes: The benchmark butterfly of Mediterranean meadows; two broods a year on umbellifer brakes.

entries.name: Stag beetle
behaviour: larvae chew through old oak stumps for three to six years
males wrestle with gape of antler mandibles on summer evenings
rarely seen except on oak pasture in July heat

voxel_model.pattern: glossy chestnut brown; males carry huge antler mandibles

entries.notes: A six-year invisible childhood in dead wood; the biggest beetle in Europe, now protected across much of its range.
